name: Colossus Grip
text: Two Heavy weapons, one in each hand, and nobody left willing to tell you it cannot be done. You may wield two Heavy weapons at once, and the dual wielding rules apply to them in full: when your primary weapon's Impact Die Explodes, your offhand weapon strikes the same target as a separate roll, and each weapon applies its own Explosion Rider. The Heavy bonus Impact Die is still added once per turn, on your first attack.

name: Breaking Point
text: You have learned exactly where steel and bone give out, and you arrive there early. Your Impact Dice from a Heavy weapon Explode on their maximum face or one below it. A die that Explodes this way counts as having rolled its maximum for every Explosion-triggered effect.

name: Rolling Thunder
text: The first crack of the storm is a promise about the rest of it. The first time each round that an Impact Die of yours Explodes, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Shockwave
text: You bring the weapon down on the ground instead of the enemy, and let the ground carry it the rest of the way. For 1 AP, 1 Momentum, and 1 Vigor Point, roll your Vigor Die against the Vigor Defense of every enemy within 15ft standing on the same surface as you. Each enemy you hit takes that damage and must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.

name: Gathering Weight
text: Ground covered is weight you get to put behind the swing. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to your Speed in a straight line toward an enemy you can see, ignoring difficult terrain. If you end that movement within your melee reach of them, add one Vigor Die to the first melee Impact Roll you make before the end of your turn.

name: Cross-Guard
text: A weapon that size is also a wall, if you get it up in time. As a Reaction when an enemy within your melee reach attacks you while you wield a Heavy weapon, spend 1 Momentum and set the haft against the blow: that enemy Downgrades its Impact Pool for that attack.

name: Overrun
text: Requires any two Iron Storm Majors. A blow that turns aside has not finished; it has only slowed. When your melee attack against an enemy results in a Glancing Blow, spend 2 Momentum and 1 Vigor Point to add two Vigor Dice to that Impact Roll. If the new total clears the target's Defense Rating the attack connects as a full hit, and its Explosion Riders apply as normal.

name: The Iron Storm
text: The storm does not stop at the enemy standing in front of you. Once per combat, for 1 AP and 2 Vigor Points, make one melee attack that adds two Vigor Dice to its Impact Roll. Every die in that roll that Explodes also deals damage equal to its Explosion die to one other enemy of your choice within 10ft of the target.
